caption: The drawing shows a detailed illustration of a dress on the left side, colored predominantly in shades of blue and white. The dress features a fitted bodice with a pointed waist and off-the-shoulder neckline, along with long, full sleeves that are blue with white inner lining and decorated with blue and black trim. The skirt of the dress is voluminous, composed of multiple tiers. The top tiers of the skirt are blue with black edging, while the lower tiers are white with a repeating black floral and geometric motif, framed by blue and black trim. On the right side of the composition, there is a faint pencil sketch of the same dress, showing its shape, structure, and detailing without any color, providing a less detailed rendition compared to the colored version. The background is plain and unadorned, drawing focus to the dresses.
title: Blue Silk Dress
